newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Austria calls for repo bids, switches repo period.
newsitem.headline: Austria calls for repo bids, switches repo period.

text.p: The Austrian central bank said on Friday it was calling for bids on ten-day securities repurchase agreements at a fixed rate of three percent, unchanged from last week.
The bank added it will switch to offering two-week repos as of January 17, departing from its routine of offering seven-day agreements to the banking system.
Bids for the ten-day repos have to be in by 1300 GMT (1400 local) on Friday, the bank added.
Last week, the central bank allotted 12.19 billion schillings in repos, filling 13 percent of bids.
